name: Batu Kawan 21K 2026
short_description: A 21.1 km half-marathon held on September 13, 2026, at Decathlon KLIPPA, Batu Kawan, Penang, Malaysia, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: Batu Kawan 21K 2026 is a half-marathon scheduled for September 13, 2026, in Batu Kawan, Penang, Malaysia. The race starts and is based at Decathlon KLIPPA, Batu Kawan, Pulau Pinang, and offers a single distance of 21.1 km. Registration for this event is currently open, giving runners in Malaysia and beyond the chance to sign up for this half-marathon.

research_highlights: The Batu Kawan 21K 2026 event offers three race categories: 5KM, 10KM, and the 21.1KM competitive run.
Registration for the Batu Kawan 21K 2026 (13 September 2026) closes on 9 August 2026 or once slots are filled, according to the Howei event listing.

Past editions of the related 'Batu Kawan Half Marathon Powered By JomRun' series (June 2026 and December 2025) used TrackAsia RFID timing chips for the 21.1KM category and offered finisher medals/jerseys strictly to finishers.

Note: Batu Kawan is also home to the much larger Aspen-Klippa Penang Bridge International Marathon (PBIM), a separate, AIMS-certified event held in December that draws around 23,000 runners across full marathon, half marathon and 10km categories — don't confuse the two events when researching.

faqs.question: When is Batu Kawan 21K 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: Batu Kawan 21K 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 13, 2026. This date marks the day runners will gather in Batu Kawan, Penang, Malaysia, to take part in the half-marathon event, so participants should plan their travel and training schedules around this specific race day.

faqs.question: What distance is offered at Batu Kawan 21K 2026?
faqs.answer: Batu Kawan 21K 2026 offers a single race distance of 21.1 km, which is the standard half-marathon distance. This is listed as the primary and only distance for this event, so runners registering should be prepared to cover the full 21.1 km course on race day.

faqs.question: Is registration open for Batu Kawan 21K 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for Batu Kawan 21K 2026 is currently open. Runners interested in taking part in this half-marathon in Batu Kawan, Penang, Malaysia, can sign up now while spots remain available, ahead of the race date on September 13, 2026.

faqs.question: Where is the race venue located?
faqs.answer: The race venue for Batu Kawan 21K 2026 is Decathlon KLIPPA, located in Batu Kawan, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia. This puts the event in the city of Batu Kawan, Penang, making it accessible to runners based in or traveling to the Penang region of Malaysia.
